data.text:
Chandan Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2024 
Author: Sandeep Kumar
Bench: Sandeep Kumar
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.35892 of 2024
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-1 Year-2017 Thana- Food And Safety (Govern
 Official) District- Muzaffarpur
 ======================================================
 Chandan Kumar Son Of Ram Naresh Patel Resident Of Naya Chowk, Kanti,
 P.S. - Kanti, District - Muzaffarpur
 ... ... Pet
 Versus
 The State Of Bihar
 ... ... Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance : 
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Shashi Bhushan Singh, Advocate  For the State : Mr.Shailendra Kumar, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 19-08-2024 Heard the parties.
2. The State is directed to file para-wise counter affidavit in this matter within six weeks. 
3. Let a copy of the brief be handed over to Mr. Jharkhandi Upadhyay, learned APP for the State. 
4. The petitioner is given liberty to file an application under Section 205 of the Cr. P.C. in the Court below which shall be considered by the Court below in accordance with law. 
5. List this case after six weeks. 
 (Sandeep Kumar, J)
